description: Test suite for the React Native template initialization and project setup in the universalinit project, including fixtures, mock configuration files, and multiple test cases covering initialization, configuration loading, and template processing.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for test outputs.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a mock template directory with configuration and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample ProjectConfig object for testing.

methods.name: test_reactnative_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests retrieval of initialization info from the ReactNativeTemplate.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a React Native project and verifying the output files.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests execution of post-processing scripts during project setup, including marker file presence.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests the ability to load project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template variables in files are correctly replaced with project parameters.
